name: Giovanni
source:
Leader of the Kirin Knight Troupe.
Owner of a beauty so gorgeous he is often mistaken for a girl, he's a natural master of fraud.
With a clear head and mouth he can lie without any remorse.
He's quite good with the rapier as well.
